qa_method: Independent re-solve from stem+choices before comparing proposed answer; then classical auxiliary meaning, connection, explanation, distractor, ID, answer-position, exact-duplicate, and high-similarity review.
ambiguity_review: Completion items explicitly finish an event before a subsequent action; continuation items explicitly maintain a resulting state with cues such as 日の暮るるまで・夜半まで・客の帰るまで・翌朝まで・今も・十年を経ても・夜明けまで・幾日たちても. Forms with 助動詞「り」 use 四段活用の已然形 only in this batch (かかれり・とどまれり・渡れり・咲けり・立てり・住めり・打てり・鳴れり・通れり・帰れり).
content_review: Confirmed that both たり and り can express completion or continuation; たり attaches to a continuative form and り to サ変未然形 or 四段已然形. All 25 stems had one defensible answer from stem+choices alone.
reference_review: Cross-checked the stable grammar rule against two external classical-Japanese grammar references before publication.
release_rule: These IDs passed independent content QA but still require the future revision-bound global semantic near-duplicate gate before production-bank approval.
